description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/ (a zero-network Cargo workspace: src/main.rs plus offline stand-ins for reqwest, rusqlite and serde_json under vendor/, pinned by Cargo.lock). They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the appsec-review/graph-export-rust pack would export (for example intermediate pattern nodes on paths and some library-summary flow pairs are omitted), written to exercise the cases below; they are not a CodeQL recording. Canonical paths of std and vendored callees follow the codeql/rust-all 0.2.21 models-as-data names and are live-unverified. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored synthetic bqrs <query_id>'.

cases.remote_to_sql: path_flows: reqwest::blocking::get (line 37) reaches <rusqlite::Connection>::execute argument 0 at line 20 through dyn Store::save and as_owned
cases.remote_to_command: path_flows: the remote body reaches Command::new argument 0 at line 42 (run_tool)
cases.remote_to_ssrf: path_flows: the remote body reaches <reqwest::blocking::client::Client>::request argument 1 at line 62 (request-url)
cases.remote_to_deserialization: sink_sites/path_flows: serde_json::from_str at line 66 is a catalog API sink (model api) reached by the remote body
cases.argv_and_env_sources: source_sites: std::env::args (line 83, commandargs) and std::env::var (line 86, environment)
cases.sanitized_path: path_sanitizers: std::fs::canonicalize (line 56) on the argv flow to fs::read_to_string at line 57, which counts one dominating sanitizer
cases.guarded_sink: guards: tool.len() < 16 (line 46) dominates Command::new at line 47, true_branch
cases.unguarded_sink: guards: Command::new at line 42 has only a none row
cases.cross_function_flow_summary: flow_summaries: as_owned parameter 0 reaches its return value (taint, through the to_string summary)
cases.virtual_dispatch: call_sites: store.save(body) at line 79 on Box<dyn Store>, two virtual_resolved candidates
cases.unresolved_indirect_call: call_sites: the closure call bump(...) at line 89 is unresolved_indirect
cases.not_applicable_range: ranges: every sink operand is not_applicable (codeql/rust-all 0.2.21 has no range analysis)
